name: Diver Seb

intro.text: I dive on the wrecks off Georgetown. Visibility is thirty metres, the water's twenty-six degrees, and the sharks are polite.

win: Well dived. Hold your breath for the next one.
after: Ascension's waters are some of the clearest in the Atlantic, with blue marlin, yellowfin tuna, wahoo and a fair few galapagos sharks.
